purpose: A QUALIFIED record means this binding was observed to make a bounded runtime repair that preserved single-owner architecture, the full acceptance list, destructive-operation safety, work identity, attempt and custody accounting, and closed both the reported instance and its recurrence - after first being rejected for an intentionally inadequate attempt and correcting once.
grants: Eligibility as the MAKER of runtime work on a route whose floor declares this contract in requires_capabilities.
does_not_grant: Any authority to review, challenge, or adjudicate a change, including its own.
Arbitrary production runtime competence; the predicate measures the named reusable contract and nothing wider.
Any statement about cost, entitlement, availability, capacity, or concurrency, each of which is a separate axis with its own owner.
Any statement about future capacity or sustained concurrency, which one bounded run cannot establish.

predicates_measured: bounded attempt-1 to attempt-2 correction after an intentionally inadequate attempt
single-owner architecture, with no second declared state owner
full ordered acceptance-criteria preservation bound to the supplied source digest
work identity, attempt, attempt budget and custody-base preservation
evidence bound to supplied artifacts, with fabrication refused
execution completion recorded separately from the candidate's own claims
executable instance-plus-recurrence behavior, not a described one
red_controls_required: the intentionally inadequate first attempt must be observed rejected
independent mutations of architecture ownership, recurrence protection, destructive safety, acceptance preservation, evidence fabrication, and custody accounting must each be observed rejected
a setup attempt against the authoritative checkout must be observed refused without writing

note: The predicate runs entirely in disposable state and refuses the authoritative checkout, so qualifying for this contract never assumes the production permission it establishes. Everything the fixture measures is a property of the job; nothing in this file names who might do it.
